about.title: About us
about.intro: SUT MLC is the Machine Learning Community at Sharif University of Technology. We run reading groups, workshops, and a small weblog so students can share what they learn.

mission.label: Mission
mission.text: We create a thoughtful place to learn, discuss, and publish ideas in machine learning with curiosity and care.

mission.label: How we work
mission.text: Through reading groups, workshops, and public notes that make technical learning feel open, clear, and human.

mission.label: What we value
mission.text: We prioritize calm teaching, good questions, and respectful collaboration across disciplines and experience levels.

leaders.name: ErmiaM
leaders.bio: Founded SUT MLC to create a clear, welcoming home for machine learning learning in public: thoughtful sessions, good writing, and a community that keeps growing with its members.

leaders.name: Erfan J.
leaders.bio: Helps guide the community’s direction, shape programs, and make sure the learning culture stays open, collaborative, and intellectually serious.
